title: The History Machine
protagonist: Ensemble across the five centres — Refilwe Mangope (Karoo, detection) as primary spine; Yusuf Salie (Antarctica, time) as the isolated second spine
logline: In 2038 a global university consortium uses the 420 Code to read the residue every event leaves in matter, building a machine that can witness any moment in history — and then the ice at the bottom of the world dates one of those moments to long before it happened.
market: near-future literary science fiction · African-centred consortium procedural · epistemic thriller
shelf: OPEN — see O-01 (recommended: African Gold companion, 2038, after Afrika 2035)
setting: 2038 — Karoo (SKA-adjacent array); Technopark, Stellenbosch; Accra; Nairobi; ARIADNE deep station, Antarctica (SANAP, run from Cape Town)
sensitivity_read: RECOMMENDED — living persons at the edge (G, AJ) held offstage by lock C-06; indigenous custody of the dead as a live argument, not set dressing; a missing-child case as the first reconstruction; courts and intelligence services as pressure, not cartoon.
